steps.description: Pre-filter to genes with >=10 counts in at least 6 samples (the smaller group size). Set condition factor levels explicitly with 'control' as reference. Fit DESeq2 with design ~condition only — do NOT add a batch term (the model matrix would not be full rank since batch B1={all controls}, B2={all treated}) and do NOT apply ComBat-seq, limma removeBatchEffect, or SVA, since any such correction would remove the condition effect together with the batch effect. Run the Wald test for the contrast condition treated vs control, apply apeglm shrinkage to the log2 fold changes, and generate MA and dispersion diagnostic plots. Report the number of genes tested after filtering and BH-adjusted results at alpha 0.05 in the multiple-testing step. Explicitly label the entire results table as CONFOUNDED: any significant gene reflects either a true treatment effect, a batch/processing effect, or both, and this design cannot distinguish them.

Explicitly recommend that any candidate gene or pathway be validated in a follow-up cohort where batch and condition are not confounded before treating it as a treatment effect.

plan.title: Lung treated vs control DE (batch-confounded, DESeq2)
plan.analytical_narrative: This dataset (12000 genes x 12 samples, salmon-derived raw integer counts, lung tissue, human) compares 6 treated vs 6 control samples, but the processing batch is perfectly confounded with condition (all controls in B1, all treated in B2). This is not fixable by any statistical adjustment: fitting a batch term makes the design matrix singular, and any batch-correction method (ComBat-seq, removeBatchEffect, SVA) would remove the condition effect together with the batch effect, since the two are mathematically identical in this design. Per the grounded procedure, the correct path is to proceed with a condition-only model, but to explicitly flag every downstream result as confounded — any 'treated vs control' difference found here cannot be distinguished from a 'B2 vs B1' processing difference. The plan runs: (1) sample-structure QC (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap, library sizes) colored by both condition and batch to visualize that the two factors are inseparable in this cohort; (2) DESeq2 standard pipeline (minimal pre-filter, median-of-ratios normalization, Wald test, apeglm shrinkage, BH-adjusted independent filtering) with a condition-only design, reporting every gene table and figure with an explicit confounding caveat; (3) fgsea preranked GSEA on the Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark and Reactome (both staged locally for human) to characterize pathway-level signal, with the same confounding caveat attached; (4) a consolidated report stating the assumption of no independent batch effect, package versions, thresholds, and the number of DE genes and enriched sets, framing all findings as hypotheses requiring a deconfounded replication cohort rather than confirmed treatment effects.

fgsea preranked GSEA on Wald statistic, MSigDB Hallmark then Reactome
DE + enrichment report with confounding caveat, diagnostics, session info
